$comment: What the platform knows about an item that the editor model does not decide, as data an editor extends without touching a line of logic (c3-select, 2026-10-25). Read whole by frontierSelection.mjs. `republishers`: sources that republish others' writing (a digest with another feed's 「AI 评分 / AI 导读」 chrome, a rewrite of a press release); keyed by the registry source id; each has its authority grade capped at `authorityCap` and never takes a floor place (`floors: false`). `ceilings`: the most a model-scored part may be for a fact the platform holds - the genre, the evidence type, a preprint, the study design c3-faith reads from the text, a registry-class source. A ceiling is the prompt's own anchor made certain, never a new opinion: the prompt says it, the model usually keeps to it, and code keeps it when the model does not. Parts are impact (0-30), novelty (0-20) and relevance (0-20).
